import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, OnChanges, SimpleChanges, ViewChild, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Message, ConversationData, FilterOptions } from '@/app/core/models'; import { FilterService } from '@/app/core/services/filter.service'; import { highlightText } from '@/app/core/utils/search.utils'; import { conversationsData } from '@/app/core/mock/conversations.data'; import { parseISO, isWithinInterval, startOfDay, endOfDay } from 'date-fns'; @Component({ selector: 'app-message-list', template: `
{{ selectedFolder }}
{{ folderUnreadCount }} /{{ folderTotalCount }} unread
{{ folder }}
{{ selectedItems.size > 0 ? selectedItems.size + ' SELECTED' : 'ALL' }}
{{ message.time }}
{{ getSenderDisplay(message) }}
{{ message.unreadCount }}
` }) export class MessageListComponent implements OnChanges { @Input() messages: Message[] = []; @Input() isLoading = false; @Input() selectedMessageId: string | null = null; @Input() searchQuery = ''; @Input() isCollapsed = false; @Output() selectMessage = new EventEmitter(); @Output() toggleCollapse = new EventEmitter(); @Output() searchChange = new EventEmitter(); @Output() markAsRead = new EventEmitter(); @Output() markAsUnread = new EventEmitter(); selectedFolder = 'Inbox'; tempSelectedFolder = 'Inbox'; filteredMessages: Message[] = []; isFolderDropdownOpen = false; isFilterOpen = false; selectedItems = new Set(); selectAll = false; activeFilters: FilterOptions = { company: null, members: [], dateRange: { from: undefined, to: undefined }, unread: false, todo: false, attachments: false }; ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges) { if (changes['messages'] || changes['searchQuery'] || changes['selectedFolder']) { this.filterMessages(); // Reset selection when list changes significantly? // If just updating messages (e.g. read status), keep selection // If changing folder, clear selection } } selectFolder(folder: string) { this.selectedFolder = folder; this.selectedItems.clear(); this.selectAll = false; this.filterMessages(); } clearFilters(event?: Event) { if (event) { event.stopPropagation(); } this.activeFilters = { company: null, members: [], dateRange: { from: undefined, to: undefined }, unread: false, todo: false, attachments: false }; this.filterMessages(); } applyDetailFilters(filters: FilterOptions) { this.activeFilters = filters; this.isFilterOpen = false; this.filterMessages(); } filterMessages() { let result = this.messages; // Folder Filter if (this.selectedFolder !== 'All Folders') { result = result.filter(m => m.folder === this.selectedFolder); } // Search Filter if (this.searchQuery && this.searchQuery.trim()) { const query = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(); result = result.filter(m => { if ((m.sender || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)) return true; if ((m.subject || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)) return true; const conv = conversationsData[m.id]; if (conv) { if ((conv.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)) return true; if (conv.messages.some((msg: any) => (msg.content || '').toLowerCase().includes(query))) return true; } return false; }); } // Advanced Filters if (this.activeFilters.company) { result = result.filter(m => m.companies.includes(this.activeFilters.company!)); } if (this.activeFilters.unread) { result = result.filter(m => m.unreadCount > 0); } if (this.activeFilters.todo) { result = result.filter(m => m.isTodo); } if (this.activeFilters.attachments) { result = result.filter(m => m.hasAttachment); } if (this.activeFilters.dateRange.from && this.activeFilters.dateRange.to) { result = result.filter(m => { if (!m.timestamp) return true; const msgDate = parseISO(m.timestamp); return isWithinInterval(msgDate, { start: startOfDay(this.activeFilters.dateRange.from!), end: endOfDay(this.activeFilters.dateRange.to!) }); }); } // Member filter would go here too this.filteredMessages = result; } handleSelectAll() { if (this.selectAll) { this.selectedItems.clear(); } else { this.filteredMessages.forEach(m => this.selectedItems.add(m.id)); } this.selectAll = !this.selectAll; } handleSelectItem(id: string) { if (this.selectedItems.has(id)) { this.selectedItems.delete(id); } else { this.selectedItems.add(id); } this.selectAll = this.selectedItems.size === this.filteredMessages.length; } handleBulkAction(action: string) { const ids = Array.from(this.selectedItems); if (ids.length === 0) return; switch (action) { case 'markRead': this.markAsRead.emit(ids); break; case 'markUnread': this.markAsUnread.emit(ids); break; case 'delete': // emit delete event break; } this.selectedItems.clear(); this.selectAll = false; } get folderUnreadCount() { return this.filteredMessages.filter(m => m.unreadCount > 0).length; } get folderTotalCount() { return this.filteredMessages.length; } get activeFilterCount() { return [ this.activeFilters.company ? 1 : 0, this.activeFilters.members.length > 0 ? 1 : 0, (this.activeFilters.dateRange.from || this.activeFilters.dateRange.to) ? 1 : 0, this.activeFilters.unread ? 1 : 0, this.activeFilters.todo ? 1 : 0, this.activeFilters.attachments ? 1 : 0 ].reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0); } highlightSubject(subject: string): string { return highlightText(subject, this.searchQuery); } getSenderDisplay(message: Message): string { const conversation = conversationsData[message.id]; if (conversation && conversation.participantsList) { const participants = conversation.participantsList; const otherParticipants = participants.filter(p => !p.toLowerCase().includes('(you)') && p !== 'You'); otherParticipants.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)); if (otherParticipants.length > 0) { const primaryName = otherParticipants[0]; const count = participants.length - 1; return count > 0 ? `${primaryName} +${count}` : primaryName; } } return message.sender; } }
